gem_value.description: 100 Ever Gems represent $1.00 of accounting value.

reader_purchase.description: When a reader purchases Ever Gems through a bundle or membership, the corresponding purchase value is recognized by Ever Joy immediately.

creator_revenue_trigger.description: Creator revenue is generated only when Ever Gems are actually spent to unlock a paid chapter.

distributed_value.description: Every 30 Ever Gems spent on a paid chapter creates $0.30 of distributed value before the creator/platform revenue split.

creator_revenue.creator_revenue_condition: Creator earnings are generated only when a reader spends Ever Gems on that creator's paid content.

membership.gem_revenue_rule: Membership Gems follow the same accounting rules as purchased Gem bundles.

gem_bundles.creator_revenue_trigger: Only Gems actually spent on paid chapters generate creator revenue.

advertising.description: Advertising revenue is accounted for separately from Ever Gems and paid chapter revenue.

collaboration.revenue_rule: After Ever Joy's platform share has been deducted, the creator share is divided according to the registered collaboration agreement.
collaboration.description: Ever Joy does not take an additional percentage from the collaboration creator pool.

creator_wallet.description: Creator balances displayed in Ever Joy are accounting ledger balances representing amounts owed to the creator. They are not stored cash balances belonging to the creator.

payouts.rollover_description: Creator earnings below the minimum payout threshold remain in the creator wallet and roll over until the creator reaches the minimum payout amount.

refunds.general_policy: Refunds are not normally permitted after Ever Gems have been spent.

exceptional_refunds.description: In exceptional circumstances where a refund is granted after Gems have been spent, Ever Joy may absorb the resulting settlement adjustment from its own platform share rather than deducting the affected creator's legitimate earnings.

creator_bonuses.description: Ever Joy may voluntarily provide small bonuses to creators, including bonuses that help a creator reach the minimum payout threshold.

copyright_infringement.description: Revenue associated with confirmed pirated, plagiarized, or copyright-infringing content is not distributed to the infringing creator.

original_work_removal.description: If an original work is removed for reasons unrelated to creator misconduct or copyright infringement, legitimate creator earnings remain payable according to Ever Joy's settlement rules.

international_creators.description: Ever Joy creator accounting and payout amounts are maintained in USD regardless of the creator's country.

platform_side_taxes.description: Taxes and applicable obligations arising within Ever Joy's platform operations are handled by Ever Joy.

creator_side_taxes.description: Creators are responsible for taxes and obligations applicable to income they receive in their own country.
